common.style_usage: Stardew Valley building pixel art: palette, outline weight, how the roofs are shaded in rows of tiles or shingles with light ridges, dark gable edges and deep shadow under the eaves, and the high top-down front camera where the roof fills over half the building
common.reference_usage: camera, silhouette and roof planes: the lighter roof colour is roof facing up toward the viewer, the darker is roof facing forward, the darkest band is the shadow under the eaves; keep this outline, these openings, and the roof taking more than half the height

emmett_cottage_s1.description: A travelling folk musician's small cottage in Stardew Valley pixel art: a warm wren-brown wooden shingle roof in rows with light ridges, a fieldstone chimney, cream plaster walls with dark timber, small paned windows, a weathered wooden door, a rough plank bench beside the door with a fiddle case on it, a lantern. STRICTLY FRONT-FACING like every Stardew Valley building: the front wall seen square-on and flat, no side walls visible, not turned or rotated, no three-quarter or isometric angle; the roof seen from above and in front, a steep front-gabled roof whose ridge runs back away from the viewer, two big shingled roof planes (lit on the left, shaded on the right) filling about 60% of the height. Building only, nothing around it, no ground, no text, transparent background.
